From STEWARD0's implementer: PolicyShowLabelledToAll (may_see) and PolicyApproverExceeds (approver_holds) cannot be caught as Policy swaps: no reachable state distinguishes the broken guard. Both check (1) channel principal == request principal and (2) the approver owns the request's domain labels plus the asked ones. (1) is kept by routing (edges::approval reaches only domains of the channel principal's account) and (2) by owns_labels at entry (a session exists in a labelled domain only if its principal owns it; a lease only via an approved request whose asked labels owns_labels checked at Submit; ownership fixed by the manifest), so every request reaching Pending/Approve already passes both; checked with a principal given a label set it does not own: nothing can exist there. Options: (a) retire both like the page's four, guards stay in the tables as defence in depth with no mutation, the page's paragraph says why (30 -> 28 mutations); (b) as (a) but drop the guards from the tables; (c) keep and catch otherwise, which it cannot see without changing owns_labels or routing. It recommends (a). Rule on the page's guard table; the implementer continues the embedder and the other mutations meanwhile.
